name: lean-ai
description: Multi-provider LLM agentic coding assistant with phase-based planning, chat & inline predictions

Lean AI: Test UI Verification Pipeline

configuration.title: Lean AI
configuration.markdownDescription:
Configure Lean AI — a local agentic coding assistant. For a guided setup with mutual exclusion between providers, use the **⚙ button** in the Lean AI sidebar. [View documentation on GitHub](https://github.com/shunobies/lean-ai/)

Changes here are synced to `backend/config.yaml` and require a backend restart.

lean-ai.backendUrl.markdownDescription: URL of the Lean AI backend server. Change this to connect to a remote backend. Default: `http://localhost:8422`

lean-ai.enableInlinePredictions.markdownDescription: Enable Copilot-style inline predictions powered by Ollama. Configure the model with `lean-ai.inlineModel`.

lean-ai.enableOsNotifications.markdownDescription: Send OS-level notifications when the plan is ready for review, a command needs approval, or a task completes. Requires `notify-send` on Linux, `osascript` on macOS, or `mshta` on Windows. Disable if these tools are unavailable.

lean-ai.autoStartBackend.markdownDescription: Automatically start the Python backend server when the extension activates. Set `lean-ai.pythonPath` if using a virtualenv.

lean-ai.pythonPath.markdownDescription: Path to the Python interpreter. Set this to a full virtualenv path if the backend is installed in one, e.g. `/home/user/Code/lean_ai/backend/.venv/bin/python`.

lean-ai.backendDir.markdownDescription: Path to the `backend/` directory containing `pyproject.toml`. If empty, auto-detects from workspace.

lean-ai.chatFontSize.markdownDescription: Font size (px) for chat messages in the Lean AI sidebar. Adjusts live without restarting. Range: 10–20.

lean-ai.userName.markdownDescription: Your name — the chat LLM will use this to address you personally.

enumDescriptions: Use a local Ollama instance (no API key required)
Use OpenAI API (requires API key stored in OS keychain)
Use Anthropic Claude API (requires API key stored in OS keychain)
Use Google Gemini API (requires API key stored in OS keychain)
Use Lean AI Serve — vLLM inference wrapper (requires API key)
lean-ai.llmProvider.markdownDescription: LLM provider for the main agent. API keys are stored securely in the OS keychain — use the ⚙ settings panel to configure them. Default: `ollama`

lean-ai.ollamaModel.markdownDescription: **Ollama** — Primary model name. Must be pulled with `ollama pull <model>`. Default: `qwen3-coder:30b`

lean-ai.ollamaContextWindow.markdownDescription: **Ollama** — Context window size in tokens. Accepts shorthand: `128` = 128k = 131072. Default: `131072`

lean-ai.ollamaTemperature.markdownDescription: **Ollama** — Sampling temperature (0.0–2.0). Higher = more creative, lower = more deterministic. Leave blank to omit and use the model's Ollama/Modelfile default.

lean-ai.ollamaTopP.markdownDescription: **Ollama** — Nucleus sampling threshold (0.0–1.0). Keeps the top tokens whose cumulative probability reaches this value. Leave blank to omit and use the model's Ollama/Modelfile default.

lean-ai.ollamaTopK.markdownDescription: **Ollama** — Top-k sampling: only the top K tokens are considered at each step. Leave blank to omit and use the model's Ollama/Modelfile default.

lean-ai.ollamaRepeatPenalty.markdownDescription: **Ollama** — Penalty applied to repeated tokens to reduce repetition (1.0 = no penalty). Leave blank to omit and use the model's Ollama/Modelfile default.

lean-ai.ollamaMinP.markdownDescription: **Ollama** — Minimum probability cutoff for nucleus sampling (e.g. `0.05`). Leave blank to omit — not all models support this parameter.

lean-ai.ollamaPresencePenalty.markdownDescription: **Ollama** — Presence penalty for topic breadth (e.g. `1.5`). Leave blank to omit — not all models support this parameter.

lean-ai.ollamaMaxTokens.markdownDescription: **Ollama** — Maximum tokens to generate per response. Defaults to 25% of the context window.

lean-ai.ollamaModelExpert.markdownDescription: **Ollama Expert Model** — A larger/reasoning model used for planning phases 3–5. Leave empty to use the primary model for all phases. Example: `qwen3:32b`

lean-ai.ollamaExpertContextWindow.markdownDescription: **Ollama Expert Model** — Context window for the expert model. Defaults to the primary model's context window.

enumDescriptions: Auto-detect from ollamaModelExpert (empty = use primary provider)
Use OpenAI for expert phases (e.g. gpt-4o for planning)
Use Anthropic for expert phases (e.g. claude-opus-4-6 for planning)
Use Gemini for expert phases (e.g. gemini-2.5-pro for planning)
Use Lean AI Serve for expert phases
lean-ai.expertLlmProvider.markdownDescription: **Expert Model** — Provider for reasoning-heavy planning phases. Leave empty to auto-detect. Mix providers: use a fast Ollama model for coding and a cloud model for planning.

lean-ai.ollamaModelRequest.markdownDescription: **Ollama Request Model** — A general-purpose model used for `/request` mode. Leave empty to use the primary model. Example: `qwen3.5:27b`

enumDescriptions: Use Lean AI Serve for /request mode
lean-ai.requestLlmProvider.markdownDescription: **Request Model** — Provider for `/request` mode (open-ended tasks). Leave empty to auto-detect.

lean-ai.openaiRequestModel.markdownDescription: **OpenAI Request Model** — Model for `/request` mode when using OpenAI provider.

lean-ai.anthropicRequestModel.markdownDescription: **Anthropic Request Model** — Model for `/request` mode when using Anthropic provider.

lean-ai.geminiRequestModel.markdownDescription: **Gemini Request Model** — Model for `/request` mode when using Gemini provider.

lean-ai.openaiBaseUrl.markdownDescription: **OpenAI** — Custom base URL for OpenAI-compatible APIs (Groq, Together AI, vLLM, etc.). Leave empty to use `api.openai.com`.

lean-ai.openaiContextWindow.markdownDescription: **OpenAI** — Context window size in tokens. Default: `128000`

lean-ai.openaiExpertModel.markdownDescription: **OpenAI Expert** — Override model for expert planning phases. Falls back to `lean-ai.openaiModel` if empty. Example: `gpt-4o`

lean-ai.anthropicContextWindow.markdownDescription: **Anthropic** — Context window size in tokens. Default: `200000`

lean-ai.anthropicExpertModel.markdownDescription: **Anthropic Expert** — Override model for expert planning phases. Falls back to `lean-ai.anthropicModel` if empty. Example: `claude-opus-4-6`

lean-ai.geminiContextWindow.markdownDescription: **Gemini** — Context window size in tokens. Default: `1048576` (1M)

lean-ai.geminiExpertModel.markdownDescription: **Gemini Expert** — Override model for expert planning phases. Falls back to `lean-ai.geminiModel` if empty. Example: `gemini-2.5-pro`

lean-ai.serveUrl.markdownDescription: **Lean AI Serve** — URL of the lean-ai-serve vLLM wrapper. Default: `http://localhost:8420`

lean-ai.serveModel.markdownDescription: **Lean AI Serve** — Model name served by lean-ai-serve. Must match the model loaded in vLLM.

lean-ai.serveContextWindow.markdownDescription: **Lean AI Serve** — Context window size in tokens. Accepts shorthand: `128` = 128k. Default: `131072`

lean-ai.serveMaxTokens.markdownDescription: **Lean AI Serve** — Maximum output tokens. Defaults to 25% of context window.

lean-ai.serveExpertModel.markdownDescription: **Lean AI Serve Expert** — Override model for expert planning phases. Falls back to `lean-ai.serveModel` if empty.

lean-ai.serveRequestModel.markdownDescription: **Lean AI Serve Request** — Override model for `/request` mode. Falls back to `lean-ai.serveModel` if empty.

lean-ai.ollamaModelWorker.markdownDescription: **Ollama Worker Model** — A small, fast model for auxiliary tasks (summarization, compression). Leave empty to disable. Example: `qwen3.5:2b-q8_0`

enumDescriptions: Auto-detect from ollamaModelWorker (empty = use primary provider)
Use Lean AI Serve for worker tasks
lean-ai.workerLlmProvider.markdownDescription: **Worker Model** — Provider for auxiliary tasks (summarization, compression). Leave empty to auto-detect.

lean-ai.ollamaWorkerContextWindow.markdownDescription: **Ollama Worker Model** — Context window. Defaults to the primary model's context window.

lean-ai.ollamaWorkerTemperature.markdownDescription: **Ollama Worker Model** — Temperature. Leave blank to omit for the worker model.

lean-ai.ollamaWorkerTopP.markdownDescription: **Ollama Worker Model** — Top-p. Leave blank to omit for the worker model.

lean-ai.ollamaWorkerTopK.markdownDescription: **Ollama Worker Model** — Top-k. Leave blank to omit for the worker model.

lean-ai.ollamaWorkerRepeatPenalty.markdownDescription: **Ollama Worker Model** — Repeat penalty. Leave blank to omit for the worker model.

lean-ai.ollamaWorkerMinP.markdownDescription: **Ollama Worker Model** — Minimum probability cutoff. Leave blank to omit for the worker model.

lean-ai.ollamaWorkerPresencePenalty.markdownDescription: **Ollama Worker Model** — Presence penalty. Leave blank to omit for the worker model.

lean-ai.ollamaWorkerMaxTokens.markdownDescription: **Ollama Worker Model** — Max tokens. Defaults to 25% of worker context window.

lean-ai.enableThinkingWorker.markdownDescription: **Worker Model** — Enable thinking mode. Disabled by default since worker model prioritizes speed.

lean-ai.openaiWorkerModel.markdownDescription: **OpenAI Worker** — Model for worker tasks when using OpenAI provider.

lean-ai.anthropicWorkerModel.markdownDescription: **Anthropic Worker** — Model for worker tasks when using Anthropic provider.

lean-ai.geminiWorkerModel.markdownDescription: **Gemini Worker** — Model for worker tasks when using Gemini provider.

lean-ai.serveWorkerModel.markdownDescription: **Lean AI Serve Worker** — Model for worker tasks when using Serve provider.

lean-ai.inlineModel.markdownDescription: **Inline Predictions** — Separate Ollama model for fill-in-the-middle completions. Uses a dedicated model for low-latency completions, independent of the main LLM provider. Example: `qwen2.5-coder:7b`

lean-ai.inlineOllamaUrl.markdownDescription: **Inline Predictions** — Ollama instance for the inline model. Falls back to `lean-ai.ollamaUrl` if empty. Useful for running a separate Ollama on a different GPU.

lean-ai.embeddingModel.markdownDescription: **Embeddings** — Ollama model for semantic search and RRF hybrid ranking. Default: `qwen3-embedding:0.6b`

lean-ai.enableEmbeddings.markdownDescription: **Embeddings** — Enable embedding generation and RRF hybrid search in the workspace index. Disable if you don't want to run an embedding model. Default: `true`

lean-ai.embeddingContextWindow.markdownDescription: **Embeddings** — Context window used to size embedding batches. Defaults to `8192` (8k) so `/init` never blocks on Ollama's `show` API. Raise for embedding models with larger context windows (e.g. `32` for qwen3-embedding). Accepts shorthand (e.g. `8` = 8k). Set `0` to re-enable auto-detect via `show` — a 5s timeout caps any hang. Default: `8192`

lean-ai.visionModel.markdownDescription: **Vision Model** — Ollama vision model for describing images attached in chat (e.g. `qwen3-vl:8b`). Leave empty to disable image support. Must be pulled with `ollama pull <model>`.

lean-ai.visionOllamaUrl.markdownDescription: **Vision Model** — Ollama endpoint for the vision model. Leave empty to use the primary Ollama URL.

lean-ai.enableStt.markdownDescription: **Voice STT** — Enable speech-to-text via faster-whisper. Click the mic icon in chat to dictate. Requires the `voice` backend extras (`pip install -e ".[voice]"`).

enumDescriptions: Turbo — fast with good accuracy, recommended (~6GB VRAM)
lean-ai.sttModel.markdownDescription: **Voice STT** — faster-whisper model size. `turbo` is recommended for a balance of speed and accuracy.

lean-ai.sttLanguage.markdownDescription: **Voice STT** — ISO 639-1 language code (e.g. `en`, `es`, `fr`). Leave empty for auto-detection.

lean-ai.enableTts.markdownDescription: **Voice TTS** — Enable text-to-speech via Kokoro. Reads LLM responses aloud (thinking + final response).

lean-ai.ttsVoice.markdownDescription: **Voice TTS** — Kokoro voice ID (e.g. `af_heart`, `am_adam`). Use the voice list in the settings panel to browse all available voices.

lean-ai.ttsSpeed.markdownDescription: **Voice TTS** — Speech rate multiplier. `1.0` = normal speed, `0.5` = half speed, `2.0` = double speed.

lean-ai.ttsCpuThreads.markdownDescription: **Voice TTS** — ONNX inference threads for Kokoro TTS. `0` = auto (`min(CPU count, 8)`). Higher values may improve synthesis speed on multi-core systems. Requires backend restart.

lean-ai.enableWakeWord.markdownDescription: **Voice Wake Word** — Say "Hey Computer" to activate STT hands-free. Requires the `voice` backend extras.

lean-ai.wakeWordAutoSubmit.markdownDescription: **Voice Wake Word** — Automatically submit transcribed text after wake word detection. When disabled, text fills the input for review before sending.

lean-ai.enableUiVerification.markdownDescription: **UI Verification** — Enable the `verify_web_ui` and `verify_desktop_ui` tools. When turned on for the first time, VS Code will prompt to install the workspace-local Chromium browser (~300MB). Requires the `ui-verification` backend extras (`pip install -e ".[ui-verification]"`) and a configured vision model.

lean-ai.supportsImagePrimary.markdownDescription: **Per-Model Capability** — Declare that the **primary** model accepts images. When checked, image uploads go directly to this model instead of round-tripping through the dedicated vision model. No model swap on VRAM-constrained hosts.

lean-ai.supportsImageExpert.markdownDescription: **Per-Model Capability** — Declare that the **expert** model accepts images. Rarely useful on its own since expert doesn't usually see user images directly.

lean-ai.supportsImageRequest.markdownDescription: **Per-Model Capability** — Declare that the **request** model (chat mode) accepts images. When set, chat image uploads skip the describe step.

lean-ai.supportsImageWorker.markdownDescription: **Per-Model Capability** — Declare that the **worker** model accepts images. The worker handles auxiliary tasks (summarisation, compression) and rarely sees user images, but supplied for symmetry.

lean-ai.supportsImageInline.markdownDescription: **Per-Model Capability** — Declare that the **inline** (FIM) model accepts images. Inline predictions don't carry images in practice; flag for symmetry only.

lean-ai.supportsAudioPrimary.markdownDescription: **Per-Model Capability** — Declare that the **primary** model accepts audio. When checked, mic recordings are transcribed by this model directly instead of faster-whisper. First in the audio priority chain.

lean-ai.supportsAudioExpert.markdownDescription: **Per-Model Capability** — Declare that the **expert** model accepts audio. Fourth in the audio priority chain.

lean-ai.supportsAudioRequest.markdownDescription: **Per-Model Capability** — Declare that the **request** model accepts audio. Second in the audio priority chain (after primary).

lean-ai.supportsAudioWorker.markdownDescription: **Per-Model Capability** — Declare that the **worker** model accepts audio. Third in the audio priority chain.

lean-ai.supportsAudioInline.markdownDescription: **Per-Model Capability** — Declare that the **inline** model accepts audio. Last in the priority chain; rarely useful since inline models are FIM-tuned.

lean-ai.uiVerificationTimeout.markdownDescription: **UI Verification** — Timeout in seconds wrapping the whole verify_ui tool call (capture + 3 vision passes + color sampling + focused answer). Vision passes are slow on small local models; raise if you hit timeouts, lower if you want faster failure.

lean-ai.uiVerificationViewport.markdownDescription: **UI Verification** — Default browser viewport for `verify_web_ui` as `WxH`. Examples: `1280x800` (desktop), `375x812` (mobile).

lean-ai.uiVerificationWaitSeconds.markdownDescription: **UI Verification** — Post-render settling time before the screenshot fires, in seconds. Covers transitions, font loading, and late-mounted content.

lean-ai.searchApiUrl.markdownDescription: **Search** — API URL for a self-hosted SearXNG instance (e.g. `http://localhost:8888/search`). Only used when `lean-ai.searchProvider` is `searxng`.

enumDescriptions: Google (Selenium-based, requires Chrome; auto-falls back to Bing)
lean-ai.searchProvider.markdownDescription: **Search** — Provider for web search used in context generation and agent tasks. Default: `duckduckgo`

lean-ai.searchDelay.markdownDescription: **Search** — Minimum seconds between search requests (with random jitter). Increase to avoid rate limiting. Default: `2.0`

lean-ai.chatMaxTurns.markdownDescription: **Advanced** — Default tool-calling turn budget for ordinary chat exploration requests. Synced to `LEAN_AI_CHAT_MAX_TURNS` / `chat_max_turns`. Default: `20`

lean-ai.chatExtendedTurnsMax.markdownDescription: **Advanced** — Maximum tool-calling turn budget allowed when a caller supplies `extended_turns` to the chat API. Synced to `LEAN_AI_CHAT_EXTENDED_TURNS_MAX` / `chat_extended_turns_max`. Default: `40`

lean-ai.enableIntegrations.markdownDescription: **Integrations** — Enable external service integrations (GitHub, Jira, ServiceNow, etc.) for two-way task sync and time tracking. Default: `false`

lean-ai.integrationAutoPush.markdownDescription: **Integrations** — Automatically push session summaries (duration, files changed, commits) to linked external tasks when a session completes. Default: `true`

lean-ai.githubRepo.markdownDescription: **Integrations / GitHub** — Target repository for GitHub issue and pull-request comments, e.g. `owner/repo`

lean-ai.githubCoauthorEnabled.markdownDescription: **Integrations / GitHub** — Append a `Co-authored-by` trailer to Lean AI-generated git commits using the built-in LeanAI bot identity by default. Default: `false`

lean-ai.githubCoauthorName.markdownDescription: **Integrations / GitHub** — Display name used in the Git co-author trailer.

lean-ai.githubCoauthorEmail.markdownDescription: **Integrations / GitHub** — LeanAI bot email used in the `Co-authored-by` trailer for GitHub credit.

lean-ai.jiraUrl.markdownDescription: **Integrations / Jira** — Jira Cloud instance URL, e.g. `https://yourcompany.atlassian.net`

lean-ai.jiraEmail.markdownDescription: **Integrations / Jira** — Jira account email address used for API authentication

lean-ai.servicenowUsername.markdownDescription: **Integrations / ServiceNow** — ServiceNow username for API authentication

lean-ai.servicenowTable.markdownDescription: **Integrations / ServiceNow** — ServiceNow table to query. Default: `incident`

lean-ai.wikiUrl.markdownDescription: **Integrations / MediaWiki** — Wiki instance URL, e.g. `https://wiki.company.com`. Leave empty to disable wiki tools.

lean-ai.wikiUsername.markdownDescription: **Integrations / MediaWiki** — Username for authenticated wikis (bot account). Leave empty for public wikis.

lean-ai.enablePostValidation.markdownDescription: **Post-Validation** — Run deterministic lint/format/test passes after the agent finishes. Automatically retries fixes up to `lean-ai.postValidationMaxRetries` times. Default: `true`

lean-ai.postFormatCommand.markdownDescription: **Post-Validation** — Command to auto-format code after changes. Example: `ruff format src/`. Falls back to auto-detected command from `/init` if empty.

lean-ai.postLintFixCommand.markdownDescription: **Post-Validation** — Command to auto-fix lint issues after changes. Example: `ruff check --fix src/`. Falls back to auto-detected command from `/init` if empty.

lean-ai.postLintCommand.markdownDescription: **Post-Validation** — Command to check for lint errors (without auto-fix). Example: `ruff check src/`. Falls back to auto-detected command from `/init` if empty.

lean-ai.postTestCommand.markdownDescription: **Post-Validation** — Command to run tests after changes. Example: `pytest tests/ -x -q`. Falls back to auto-detected command from `/init` if empty.

lean-ai.postValidationMaxRetries.markdownDescription: **Post-Validation** — Maximum LLM fix attempts when lint/tests fail. The expert model is used on the final retry if configured. `0` = no retries. Default: `2`

lean-ai.postValidationFixTurns.markdownDescription: **Post-Validation** — Tool-calling turns allowed per fix attempt. Increase for complex failures or fast cloud models; decrease for slow local models. Default: `30`

lean-ai.enableRequiredCitations.markdownDescription: **Advanced** — Mandate documentation verification and citation for external framework/library/API usage during planning and execution. Default: `true`

lean-ai.refinerReferenceChunks.markdownDescription: **Advanced** — Number of reference library chunks injected into the refiner context when using a cloud LLM provider. Higher values provide more domain material but use more prompt space. Default: `5`

lean-ai.referenceChunkChars.markdownDescription: **Advanced** — Target characters per prose chunk in the reference library (~4 chars = 1 token). Larger values give the LLM more coherent passages but reduce retrieval precision. Changing this triggers a full reference-index rebuild on the next `/index-reference`. Default: `1800` (~450 tokens)

lean-ai.referenceNeighborWindow.markdownDescription: **Advanced** — Number of adjacent chunks included on each side of a `search_reference` hit. Contiguous hits are merged into one passage. `0` disables expansion. Default: `2`

lean-ai.referenceSearchDefaultLimit.markdownDescription: **Advanced** — Default number of hits returned by `search_reference` when the LLM does not specify a limit. Each hit may be a multi-chunk passage when neighbor expansion is enabled. Default: `5`

lean-ai.implementationMaxTurns.markdownDescription: **Advanced** — Maximum tool-calling turns per agent session. `0` = unlimited. Increase only if agents are cutting off early. Default: `0`

lean-ai.refreshThreshold.markdownDescription: **Advanced** — Refresh context when token usage reaches this fraction of the context window. Lower values refresh more aggressively; higher values keep more history. Default: `0.7`

lean-ai.numParallel.markdownDescription: **Context Generation** — Maximum concurrent LLM requests during `/init`. Set this to match your `OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL` value. Higher values speed up `/init` but use more VRAM. Default: `1`

lean-ai.debugPlanning.markdownDescription: **Advanced** — Save all planning phase outputs to `.lean_ai/plan_debug/{session_id}/` for debugging. Default: `false`

lean-ai.enableThinking.markdownDescription: **Ollama** — Enable thinking/reasoning mode for models that support it (Qwen3, Qwen3.5). Shows reasoning in chat. Disable for faster responses without deep reasoning. Default: `true`

lean-ai.enableThinkingExpert.markdownDescription: **Ollama Expert Model** — Enable thinking/reasoning mode for the expert model. Default: `true`

lean-ai.enableThinkingRequest.markdownDescription: **Ollama Request Model** — Enable thinking/reasoning mode for the request model. Default: `true`

lean-ai.ollamaExpertTemperature.markdownDescription: **Ollama Expert Model** — Sampling temperature. Leave blank to omit for the expert model.

lean-ai.ollamaExpertTopP.markdownDescription: **Ollama Expert Model** — Nucleus sampling threshold (top-p). Leave blank to omit for the expert model.

lean-ai.ollamaExpertTopK.markdownDescription: **Ollama Expert Model** — Top-k sampling. Leave blank to omit for the expert model.

lean-ai.ollamaExpertRepeatPenalty.markdownDescription: **Ollama Expert Model** — Repeat penalty. Leave blank to omit for the expert model.

lean-ai.ollamaExpertMinP.markdownDescription: **Ollama Expert Model** — Minimum probability cutoff. Leave blank to omit for the expert model.

lean-ai.ollamaExpertPresencePenalty.markdownDescription: **Ollama Expert Model** — Presence penalty. Leave blank to omit for the expert model.

lean-ai.ollamaExpertMaxTokens.markdownDescription: **Ollama Expert Model** — Maximum output tokens. Defaults to 25% of expert context window.

lean-ai.ollamaRequestContextWindow.markdownDescription: **Ollama Request Model** — Context window. Accepts shorthand notation (e.g. `128` = 128k). Leave empty to inherit from the primary model.

lean-ai.ollamaRequestTemperature.markdownDescription: **Ollama Request Model** — Sampling temperature. Leave blank to omit for the request model.

lean-ai.ollamaRequestTopP.markdownDescription: **Ollama Request Model** — Nucleus sampling threshold (top-p). Leave blank to omit for the request model.

lean-ai.ollamaRequestTopK.markdownDescription: **Ollama Request Model** — Top-k sampling. Leave blank to omit for the request model.

lean-ai.ollamaRequestRepeatPenalty.markdownDescription: **Ollama Request Model** — Repeat penalty. Leave blank to omit for the request model.

lean-ai.ollamaRequestMinP.markdownDescription: **Ollama Request Model** — Minimum probability cutoff. Leave blank to omit for the request model.

lean-ai.ollamaRequestPresencePenalty.markdownDescription: **Ollama Request Model** — Presence penalty. Leave blank to omit for the request model.

lean-ai.ollamaRequestMaxTokens.markdownDescription: **Ollama Request Model** — Maximum output tokens. Defaults to 25% of request context window.

lean-ai.preserveThinkingPrimary.markdownDescription: **Preserve Thinking** — Qwen3.6+/vLLM feature. When enabled, the **primary** model's prior-turn chain-of-thought is kept in the conversation history via `chat_template_kwargs` so the model doesn't re-derive the same reasoning across tool-loop iterations. Improves KV-cache reuse. Ignored by providers that don't honor chat_template_kwargs.

lean-ai.preserveThinkingExpert.markdownDescription: **Preserve Thinking** — As above, for the **expert** model.

lean-ai.preserveThinkingRequest.markdownDescription: **Preserve Thinking** — As above, for the **request** model.

lean-ai.preserveThinkingWorker.markdownDescription: **Preserve Thinking** — As above, for the **worker** model.

enumDescriptions: Off — no soft limit (safety rail still applies)
Max — unlimited soft (safety rail still applies)
lean-ai.reasoningEffortPrimary.markdownDescription: **Reasoning Effort** — Soft cap on thinking tokens for the **primary** model. Ollama enforces via a client-side stream interrupt; OpenAI/Serve forward `reasoning_effort`; Anthropic sets `thinking.budget_tokens`; Gemini sets `thinking_budget`. Leave blank to use the provider default.

lean-ai.reasoningEffortExpert.markdownDescription: **Reasoning Effort** — As above, for the **expert** model. Leave blank to use the provider default for this model.

lean-ai.reasoningEffortRequest.markdownDescription: **Reasoning Effort** — As above, for the **request** model. Leave blank to use the provider default for this model.

lean-ai.reasoningEffortWorker.markdownDescription: **Reasoning Effort** — As above, for the **worker** model. Leave blank to use the provider default for this model.

lean-ai.maxThinkingTokens.markdownDescription: **Max Thinking Tokens (Safety Rail)** — Universal cap. Applies to providers where we enforce client-side (Ollama); cloud providers rely on their own native caps. Fires even when Reasoning Effort is set to Max — catches runaway loops.

scripts.package: npm run copy-backend && npm run build && vsce package
